processes.name: Dealer Order Intake & Quoting
processes.description: Process for receiving dealer configuration requests, generating model-specific quotes using pricing workbooks, securing order acceptance, and handing off to production.
pain_points: Manual Excel pricing workbooks and template reliance
Dealer-set retail prices create margin ambiguity for factory billing
Quote approval bottlenecks between coordinator and sales manager

processes.name: Production Scheduling & Shop Floor Management
processes.description: Planning weekly production runs, maintaining the Excel schedule and shop whiteboard, managing order changes, tracking material shortages, and coordinating floor handoffs.
pain_points: Separate Excel schedule, order register, and inventory sheets
Paper work orders traveling through the shop without digital tracking
Reactive management of change requests and component shortages

processes.name: Purchasing, Receiving & Inventory Control
processes.description: Managing supplier orders, receiving materials at the bay, tracking stock via Excel/QuickBooks, and handling component shortages (e.g., axles) to keep assembly lines stocked.
pain_points: Excel stock sheets disconnected from QuickBooks supplier bills
Manual receiving paperwork and weekly physical counts
Reactive shortage management for critical components like axles

processes.name: Manufacturing/Assembly & Quality Inspection
processes.description: Cutting, welding, painting, wiring, and assembling trailer components (frames, panels, running gear), followed by model-specific pre-shipment inspection before leaving the facility.
pain_points: Coordinating multiple sub-assembly stages (cutting, welding, painting)
Ensuring model-specific option compliance before shipping
Pre-shipment inspection bottlenecks causing delivery delays

processes.name: Shipping, Invoicing & Dealer Delivery Coordination
processes.description: Arranging dealer pickup or appointment-based delivery, generating factory invoices, and handling status inquiries while dealers manage retail pricing and final handoff.
pain_points: Dealer-arranged delivery scheduling creates coordination overhead
Invoicing separated from dealer retail pricing structures
Frequent status calls requiring dedicated account coordination

processes.name: Warranty Claims & Post-Sale Support
processes.description: Processing dealer-reported issues, evaluating claims against specific warranty terms, approving repairs, and managing returns or credits without blanket coverage rules.
pain_points: No blanket coverage policy requires claim-by-claim evaluation
Repair approval delays impact dealer satisfaction and cash flow
